visual_logic: Highlights the ultra-long, needle-thin, tightly crowded interlocking teeth extending all the way to the back of the Boreopterus jaw.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a full jaw set from a Boreopterus, showcase-focused on its 'Needle Cage Braces' dentition, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The extremely long, thin jaws are densely packed with exceptionally long, slender, sharp needle-like ivory fangs that project aggressively outward and interlock perfectly when closed, forming a complex lattice cage. The teeth possess a highly polished, clean enamel coat with subtle wet-look highlights. The specimen is oriented horizontally and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to accentuate the fine, crowded complexity of the interlocking needle rows.
